initial.name: web_browser_click
initial.description: Click one element of the test page this Session controls. Take the reference and the page generation from your most recent observation; a reference from an older generation is refused, because the page may have moved. Observe the page again afterwards to see what changed.

ref.description: Element reference from your most recent observation.

initial.name: web_browser_observe
initial.description: Read the test page this Session controls: its address, its title, and the elements you can act on, each with the reference a click or type command needs. Every observation starts a new page generation, so act only on references from the most recent one.

initial.name: web_browser_screenshot
initial.description: Capture the test page this Session controls as a PNG image, for reading a page whose elements the observation does not name.

initial.name: web_browser_type
initial.description: Type text into one element of the test page this Session controls. Take the reference and the page generation from your most recent observation; a reference from an older generation is refused, because the page may have moved. Observe the page again afterwards to see the result.

ref.description: Element reference from your most recent observation.

text.description: Text to type into the element.
